A Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN), plus either a completed Master’s degree in Nursing or a related field, or active enrollment in a Master’s program with completion required within three (3) years of hire. Alternatively, a Bachelor’s degree in a non-nursing field or an Associate Degree in Nursing (ADN), combined with a completed Master’s degree in Nursing (MSN or MS), is accepted.
Five (5) years of related / relevant experience in a surgical clinic, inpatient unit, Pre-op PACU or Pre-Anesthesia Clinic setting.
Experience in resource management and budgeting.
Two (2) years of supervisory or leadership experience.
Demonstrated project, process, or quality improvement experience
Demonstrated experience managing daily operations of a nursing unit, or staff scheduling.
Experience working at a Level 1 Trauma Center
Experience working at an Academic Medical Center
Experience working in a Magnet Designated Hospital setting
Demonstrated experience in performance evaluations, staff development, team collaboration, and conflict resolution
Experience using the electronic medical record , EPIC preferred

The Pre Anesthesia Clinic (PAC) Manager provides administrative oversight and works collaboratively as a member of Perioperative Services Leadership with Medical Directors, providers and staff to optimize patient care. The PAC manager exercises independent judgement and also uses leadership and interpersonal skills to facilitate collaborative communication to advance the goals of the PAC. The Pre-Anesthesia Clinic Manager is responsible for providing direct supervision to NP’s Advanced Practice Providers (APP’s), RN’s, and non-clinical staff in the PAC. Provides direction to the team who is responsible for patient evaluation, testing, diagnosis, plans of care and treatment within PAC.
50% - Operational Oversight
40% - Leadership & Quality Improvement
5% - Professional Development / Education /Research
DEA within three (3) months of hire, as it applies
Supervising in a union environment
Adapts to change in a positive, professional and productive manner.
Proficiency in developing and updating unit policies and procedures to align with best practices and regulatory requirements.
Ability to meet minimum standards for hospital credentialing and billing standards as a billable provider.
Excellent verbal and written communications skills to interact and collaborate effectively with diverse internal and external customers including patients, physicians, management, and staff.
Self-direction and organizational skills to function in an independent role, carry out directives from Perioperative Services Nurse Director; and set objectives and priorities for staff.
Demonstrates accountability and professionalism at all times serving as a role model.
Knowledge of legal and risk implications in clinical practice and documentation
Knowledge of performance improvement and evidence-based practice
Critical thinking skills including strategic planning, operational process analysis and service recovery
Advanced knowledge of pathophysiology and nursing process to provide clinical leadership within the Perioperative Division. Knowledge of professional standards.
Demonstrated knowledge of regulatory requirements, policies and contracts and ability to ensure compliance.
Sound assessment and decision making skills to respond quickly to changing patient care and staff needs
Ability to read, write, speak, and understand the English language
